checks.description: Which checks run. enable keeps only the listed checks; disable removes checks. Both may be used.

gateCleanupDays.description: G02: days a gate may stay launched or disabled before cleanup is due.

singleOutcomeDays.description: G03: days an in-progress gate may serve one value to everyone.

partialRolloutDays.description: G04: days a partial rollout may stay unchanged.

zeroTrafficMinAgeDays.description: G06: a gate younger than this is never reported for zero traffic.

experimentCleanupDays.description: E02: days after a decision before cleanup is due.

experimentMaxRunDays.description: E03: days an experiment with no planned duration may run.

ruleChurnWindowDays.description: A01: window for counting rule changes.

ruleChurnMinChanges.description: A01: changes within the window that count as churn.

allowlistMinSize.description: G10: shortest inline ID list compared across entities.

maxPrimaryMetrics.description: E04: most primary metrics before the experiment is flagged.

naming.description: N01 patterns, as JavaScript regular expressions. null turns a pattern off.

junkPattern.description: Ids that match this look like scratch entities. Matched without case.

ignore.description: Findings to suppress. A rule matches when every key it sets matches.

auditLogDays.description: Days of audit log to read.
